scenes.title: Scene 1: Treetop Treasure
scenes.caption: Playful Monkey and cozy Sloth spot a big golden bunch of bananas in the canopy!

scenes.title: Scene 2: Parade Through the Palms
scenes.caption: Tiger and Lion march proudly down the jungle trail carrying the banana feast!

scenes.title: Scene 3: Waterfall Jungle Party
scenes.caption: Snake and Frog welcome Tiger and Lion to the waterfall for a happy jungle party!
